decisions.reason: The Discord community setup does not change the landing-page copy, layout, or referral invitation label.
Discord server setup does not affect the Transak provider, fiat payment methods, wallet provisioning, or mint destination.
The community-server decision is unrelated to optional gratuity behavior and its follow-up transaction notice.

The approved FAQ says Discord is unavailable until real traction, while this source authorizes creating and configuring a Discord server. It is unclear whether the server is now intended to launch publicly or is only being prepared privately, so revising the support-channel copy requires clarification.
Discord configuration does not change IPFS storage, Pinata usage, or the ebook takedown option.
A Discord welcome channel and bot do not alter Brevo delivery, winner emails, or mint-confirmation email contents.
The Discord community setup has no necessary effect on the badge set, Community Orbit icon, or badge layout.
The About page's general community vision does not require alteration merely because a Discord server will be configured.
Discord setup does not affect ETH pricing, swap behavior, shortfall handling, or excess refunds.
The source decision does not change checkout currency selection or payment-option availability.
Discord community configuration does not change authentication requirements for public APIs.
The Discord decision has no effect on the connected-wallet USDC mint flow.
